editorial:
Imagine being the one who is supposed to catch the criminals, but suddenly you are the one running for your life. You follow three police officers who find themselves in a nightmare after a young man dies during a clash. Because an election is coming up, the higher-ups don't want a scandal, so they turn these officers into scapegoats. The vibe is tense and stressful from the start, making you feel the panic as these men realize that the very system they served has completely turned against them.

What really works here is the acting and the way the story builds pressure. You will love how the plot keeps you guessing, though some might find the middle part a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about power and corruption, you should definitely check this out. It is a solid pick if you want something more than just a typical action flick.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a heavy note. After running for a long time, the officers realize they cannot win against the powerful political machine. They are eventually cornered by their own colleagues. Instead of a happy ending, the story shows how the system protects the powerful and crushes the small players. It wraps up by highlighting that truth often loses to political gain, leaving you feeling stunned and thoughtful about how the world works.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty crime dramas and stories about corruption.
